standard_prerequisites.use: The affine-restriction morphism f^{-1}(U) to Spec of the sections.

core_obligations: The counit varphi: f^* f_* O_X to O_X corresponds to the identity of f_* O_X under push-pull adjointness, hence is an element of the functor F on X; the representing property produces the morphism can: X to the relative spectrum over S.
Over an affine open U of S the restriction of can to f^{-1}(U) is identified, via the affine description of the relative spectrum, with the canonical morphism into Spec of the sections.
proof_roadmap: Produce the morphism from the counit through the representing property, then identify the affine restrictions via the affine description.
difficulty_reason: Universal-property construction: the counit of push-pull adjointness is an element of the represented functor and produces can; the affine restriction is identified through the affine description of the relative spectrum; fully displayed.
